title: OG-01: Freeze the Anatomical Baseline and Failure Fixtures
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Preserve the pinned model, capture, original validity masks, motions, runtime and geometry hashes. Reproduce the missing club and arm discontinuity at address, top, impact event if observed, and finish. Extract numeric joint centers, mesh bounds, bilateral segment lengths, per-marker residuals and grip frames; distinguish observed defects from hypotheses. Record current jobs without interrupting them.

## TDD and Reuse

Extend existing model audit and tests/opensim/test_opensim_os0_qualification.py. First add failing fixtures for empty Club geometry and a deliberately inconsistent mesh/joint scale. Keep the historical model as a rejected fixture rather than making baseline tests expect it to pass.

## Acceptance

A versioned baseline receipt and front/side/down-line views reproduce both defects. All referenced files resolve by hash. Missing meshes, unknown capture identity and empty geometry fail with typed reasons. No production model edits or new optimization.

## Execution

Tier: cheap. Dependencies: none; inspection first.

## Engineering Contract

- TDD: land a reproducing failing test, smallest implementation, then refactor; record RED/GREEN commands and nonzero native counts. Pure tests run without OpenSim; missing SDK is not a release pass.
- DbC: validate finite values, units, frames, shape, hashes, capabilities and bounds at public boundaries with the existing contracts module. Postconditions establish output identity and invariants; typed errors preserve unavailable/invalid status.
- LoD: isolate OpenSim SDK calls behind the existing adapter; UI/shared services consume protocols and data records, not SDK object chains.
- DRY: reuse TourCapture, marker calibration, ClubSpec, opensim_golf FK, existing registry/receipts and launcher. Discover existing APIs before adding files; proposed test names are locations, not permission for duplicate frameworks.
- Own worktree/claim/lease/presence required. Preserve active #10341 jobs and source branch. No bulk model overwrite, threshold relaxation or main push. Update governing development-log row, handoff and receipt in the same PR.
- One child per PR. Read EPIC_GOLF_MODEL.md and GOLF_MODEL_AGENT_PROMPT.md in PR #10393. Escalate anatomical/physical choices; do not spend repeated long solves on unexplained failures.

title: OG-02: Make Segment Scaling Anatomically and Physically Consistent
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Replace the joint-offset-only scaling pathway with one coherent native scaling operation or a demonstrated equivalent. Review marker proxies, nominal lengths and bilateral asymmetry before changing scale values. Apply consistent geometry/joint/marker/wrap-path transforms; explicitly select mass/inertia policy. Do not stretch a bone mesh to disguise an incorrect joint center. Preserve the old model and produce a new model identity.

## TDD and Reuse

Extend tests/opensim/test_segment_scale.py and add native scale-consistency regressions. RED: non-unit scaling moves joint endpoints but not mesh landmarks in the current driver. Test identity scaling, a known uniform scale, asymmetric input review, negative/nonfinite factors, repeat scaling protection and positive physical inertia. For a fixed-mass uniform scaling fixture inertia follows s^2; other policies get their own analytical oracle.

## Acceptance

Native joint/mesh landmark comparison meets documented numerical fixture tolerances and reviewed anatomical tolerances at all key poses. Geometry, COM, inertia and future path components have explicit policies and hashes. Record before/after segment and residual tables; do not approve right humerus 1.4567 versus left 1.2436 without justified anthropometry.

## Execution

Tier: expert-reviewed implementation. Dependencies: OG-01 (#10395).

title: OG-03: Add a Visible Parameterized Golf Club and Grip Frames
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Attach shaft, grip and recognizable head geometry to the existing Club body; support driver and iron variants using shared ClubSpec. Map the shared head-origin convention explicitly to OpenSim grip-origin/-Y shaft convention. Define clubface, sweet spot and both grip frames. Separate a visualization-only change from any mass/inertia/length change. Preserve existing physical properties for the initial visual fix.

## TDD and Reuse

Extend existing opensim_golf/fk.py tests and add tests/opensim/test_golf_club_geometry.py. RED: current Club has empty attached_geometry. Verify positive dimensions, nonempty geometry, shaft endpoint/head/grip transforms, proper handedness, deterministic generation and XML save/reload. A visual-only edit must preserve dynamics-related fields and FK.

## Acceptance

Club visible from three canonical views at address/top/finish, head/shaft align with measured club markers, driver/iron lengths come from a named spec. title: OG-04: Qualify Capture Registration and Golf Camera Views
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Separate capture-to-world rigid registration, model root pose and viewer camera. Use the existing TourCapture units/vertical-axis metadata, declared target line/ground and valid landmarks. Apply one proper rigid transform consistently to all positions/vectors/loads with correct vector semantics; record inverse and provenance. No arbitrary yaw correction chosen to make one screenshot attractive. Provide front, side and down-line camera presets separately.

## TDD and Reuse

Add tests/opensim/test_golf_registration.py around shared registration helpers after discovery. Synthetic known transform and inverse must recover landmarks within 1e-8 m; reject reflections, unit mismatch and insufficient/degenerate landmarks. Changing camera must leave model states, metrics and hashes unchanged.

## Acceptance

Registered overlays agree in three views and reproduce across engines using the same capture contract. Report yaw/translation and uncertainty. If target direction is unavailable, require explicit metadata and report unverified orientation; never silently rotate only the model.

title: OG-05: Calibrate and Match a Two-Handed Address Pose
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Fit a verified address window, not an assumed arbitrary first frame, with bounded anatomical marker offsets, reviewed segment lengths, joint limits, foot support, both hands on the grip and observed club pose. Report torso/pelvis orientation, elbow flexion, wrist location, stance width and club lie/shaft direction. Use correct anatomical landmarks rather than treating skin-marker centroids as joint centers. Hold out landmarks/frames to prevent marker-offset overfit.

## TDD and Reuse

Extend shared marker_calibration and tests/opensim/test_marker_calibration.py; add tests/opensim/test_golf_address.py. RED fixtures: left hand disconnected, yaw error, stretched segment, invalid marker and out-of-range coordinate. Use known-pose synthetic recovery and native assembly/constraint residual tests. Freeze tolerance profile before optimization; report unobservable quantities explicitly.

## Acceptance

Publish capture overlay, per-landmark RMS/max, bilateral grip closure, foot clearance and coordinate-limit report. Proposed engineering static profile: valid-marker RMS <=12 mm, max <=30 mm, grip positional closure <=5 mm; expert must approve or amend with rationale before use, then freeze/hash it. These are not validated physiological thresholds or a replacement for MS-100. If infeasible, report evidence and stop, not threshold relaxation.

## Execution

Tier: expert-reviewed fit. Dependencies: OG-02 (#10396), OG-03 (#10397), OG-04 (#10398).

title: OG-07: Introduce Versioned Model Variants and Actuation Capabilities
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Extend existing model registry/adapter contracts with stable anatomical frame IDs, coordinate/state maps, geometry assets, calibration/club spec hashes and explicit torque versus muscle/tendon capabilities. Use composition: anatomical skeleton + golf equipment/grip + calibration + actuation profile. Do not create another registry or universal model framework. A muscle variant may have extra states/coordinates; map by stable identity and reject incompatible replay.

## TDD and Reuse

Add tests/opensim/test_golf_model_variants.py after locating registry tests. RED: loading torque controls as muscle activations, unknown state, missing mesh, stale hash and silent optional-feature fallback. Identity/no-op variant preserves FK and source. Same-skeleton actuation changes preserve coordinate mapping but require explicit actuator/internal-state mapping.

## Acceptance

A torque model and minimal muscle/tendon test fixture traverse the same adapter API, with truthful capabilities and typed unsupported outcomes. Controls retain units and meanings. GUI capability labels agree with the manifest. SDK objects do not leak into shared/UI layers.

title: OG-08: Qualify Muscle and Tendon Extensions Without Replacing the Baseline
body:
Part of OpenSim epic #10394, under matched-swing epic #10363.

## Scope

Inventory existing muscle_analysis.py, POST_MVP_MUSCLES.md and issue #4296 before new work. Select legally usable anatomy with explicit lower/upper-body coverage; a lower-limb model is not a full golf muscle model. Review shoulder/scapula, forearm and hand requirements plus head/neck scope. Qualify path/wrapping, moment arms, strength, fiber/tendon parameters, activation dynamics and initial equilibrium. Keep torque baseline as a regression variant.

## TDD and Reuse

Extend tests/opensim/test_muscle_cmc.py and native muscle tests. RED for absent muscle assets, invalid path/parameters, uninitialized tendon state and unsupported anatomy claims. Compare moment arms against finite-difference path-length derivatives across a reviewed pose set; test activation bounds, equilibrium and native short replay before full swing.

## Acceptance

Expert-signed coverage and parameter provenance, licensing and model/SDK hashes. Independent #10375 validation governs force/activation claims. Reserves and residuals remain reported. Existing scale tool does not automatically qualify muscle strength. Future-ready interfaces can ship before full muscle validation, but epic muscle-complete status stays open.

title: OG-09: Package a Golf-Like Native Viewer and Release Evidence
body:

## Scope

Label IK, rejected replay and accepted dynamic results clearly. Unsupported muscles show unavailable, not an empty enabled toggle.
